reviews.text: We love Maykus Homes! Our first experience in 2010 was excellent, so after moving out of Texas for a few years we decided to have Maykus build us another home when we moved back.  The whole team is great to work with - and our house looks great! It is really comforting to know what's beneath the surface of a Maykus home (solid framing, zip board wall sheating where others use styrophome or even paper, etc.) - peace of mind that we live in more than just pretty interior and exterior surfaces.  Can't recommend them enough, and would definately use them again!
reviews.author: Brad Beakley

reviews.text: My wife and I bought a Maykus home after it had been started (framed with roof), and were very happy to work the the Maykus team which consists of the Maykus family members and qualified staff whom are extremely helpful, patient and and professional.  Throughout the the build process the Maykus team helped us make modifications to the existing plans, work with us through the design process, and they were very responsive to questions and minor changes we made.  This was the first construction loan and house we had built and the Maykus team made it a pleasurable experience...all while we were remote when the house was being built.  Strongly recommend to anyone looking for a high quality, well engineered home, with style.
reviews.author: Martin Alkis

reviews.text:
I cannot express how thrilled I am with my experience purchasing a home from Maykus Homes. From start to finish, they have exceeded my expectations and delivered a home that truly feels like a dream that came true.

When it came to the construction of our home, Maykus Homes demonstrated exceptional craftsmanship. The quality of workmanship and attention to detail was remarkable and still surprises me today. It's evident that Maykus Homes takes great pride in their work, and it shows in every corner of my home.
The level of communication and transparency was also very impressive.
reviews.author: Brandon Dornak

reviews.text: Our family has loved our Maykus Home so much that our son-in-law and daughter have bought one as well.  It is a pleasure to work with all of the great  people at Maykus Homes.  They are all true professionals and experts at their craft!  I have personally experienced the excellent abilities of Doug and Eric as truly competent home builders.
reviews.author: Mike Faulkner

reviews.text:
Maykus Homes was instrumental in my home building process. They were very professional and had great communication throughout the entire process. I moved into my home about a month and a half ago and could not be happier with the quality and how everything turned out.

Maykus treats everyone like family and that goes a long way. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Chris Brainard

reviews.text: I bought a house from Maykus Homes in March 2021.  It was one of the easiest transitions I have ever experienced, but the most important thing is the quality of their homes.  This is the best built home I have ever lived in - the quality of the workmanship; the materials that were used; top notch appliances, flooring, encapsulated foam insulation; etc., etc.  it was a pleasure to do business with Maykus Homes and I cannot say enough great things about my new home.
reviews.author: Jan Costa

reviews.text: Maykus is a first class organization.  They build an outstanding home and stand behind their quality work. Eason is carrying on a tremendous family tradition. In addition, the customer service has been outstanding. Eric will make sure all the loose ends are taken care of to your liking!!
reviews.author: Aaron Speer

reviews.text: Partnering with Maykus Homes for the build of our new home was an exceptional experience from the beginning to the final product. We are thrilled with the quality and craftsmanship of our house. The entire team was excellent every step of the way. Thank you Maykus Homes! We love our new home!
reviews.author: Samantha McCrory

data.summary: Reviews appear highly authentic. The detailed, specific content about construction processes, named employees, and personal customer stories strongly indicates real experiences. The lack of negative reviews in the sample is notable but plausible for a high-quality, family-run builder with a strong reputation. The minor 'fake signals' are outweighed by the overwhelming evidence of authenticity.
fake_signals: Some reviews use slightly generic, promotional language
authentic_signals: Specific details about construction (zip board, framing, foam insulation)
Mention of family members and staff by name (Doug, Eric, Eason)
Varied writing styles and personal anecdotes
Long-term customer relationships and repeat business mentioned
Owner responses are personalized and professional
data.discrepancy_explanation: Ratings are consistently high across Google (4.9) and Yelp (4.5). BBB A+ rating indicates good complaint handling. No significant discrepancies.
